description:
`CreatePartner` Restful API accepts soft-deleted users

### Summary
A normal authenticated user can create a partner relationship where `sharedWithId` points to a soft-deleted user. Immich returns `201 Created` and persists the relationship in the `partner` table.

This is inconsistent with other user relationship APIs, such as album sharing, which reject soft-deleted users with `400 {"message":"Invalid user"}`.

tests_added: partner.service.spec.ts: should throw an error when sharedWithId does not resolve to an existing (non-deleted) user

evidence: test: partner.service.spec.ts: should throw an error when sharedWithId does not resolve to an existing (non-deleted) user

notes: Symptom report (CreatePartner accepts soft-deleted users). Fix adds userRepository.get(sharedWithId, {}) null check in PartnerService.create; get() excludes deleted users (user.repository.ts:56). RC exact.
Mild leak: the report quotes the sibling behaviour {"message":"Invalid user"}, the exact message the fix throws; states expected behaviour only, not the code. Easy/high-lexical stratum is consistent.
Low-severity leak flagged by the auditor: kept (auditor verdict stands).
